name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, SUGS Lloyd Limited is a technology-driven engineering and construction company specializing in renewable energy, particularly solar energy, as well as electrical transmission, distribution, and civil EPC.[1]
keyPoints:
Service Offerings[1]
a) EPC services for solar, electrical, and civil projects: Design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 51.0%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 185 days.
